subject: Co-sell PSC integration & transactable SKU migration plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Co-sell PSC integration & transactable SKU migration plan

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I wanted to outline a lightweight operational plan so we can move Acme’s existing marketplace SKUs to transactable entitlements and get you on the Redwood "Sell-With / PSC" pathway for co-sell motions. High level: we need (1) PSC mapping confirmation from AWS/GCP, (2) a transactable SKU list we can upload to the catalog, and (3) an MOU that captures pricing floor, revenue split, and co-sell SLAs.

Attached: psc-mapping-v2.xlsx (mapping of Acme product SKUs -> PSC entitlements), transactable-sku-list.json (canonical SKU IDs + metering/wattage).

Proposed timeline (target):
- By EOD Thu 23 Jul: Acme to confirm SKU list and any region exclusions.
- Fri 24 Jul — Mon 27 Jul: Redwood to stage SKUs in the sandbox catalog and run a vendor test with AWS PSC (end-to-end purchase flow).
- Tue 28 Jul: joint validation call (30 min) to confirm entitlements + pricing floor enforcement in portal.
- Wed 29 Jul: final MOU sign-off and production push for initial sellers.

Key asks from you (Priya):
- Confirm final list or flag any SKUs that cannot be transactable (licensing/third-party).
- Provide the list of 3 seller accounts you want in the pilot (email addresses).
- Confirm if Acme wants to opt-in to Redwood-managed billing for the pilot or route via your private offer.

Notes / constraints from our side:
- Pricing floors: we enforce per-SKU floor at the marketplace product-level; we can surface custom promotions but they must be approved by Redwood & cloud partner PSC.
- Metering: for billed usage we map to token/embedding units — see transactable-sku-list.json for mapping keys.

Next steps: Once you confirm the SKU list I’ll schedule the PSC validation with AWS and loop in GCP ops for parity testing. If you’d like, Ben and Olga will join the validation call for entitlements and billing flows.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
(650) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: psc-mapping-v2.xlsx (xlsx), transactable-sku-list.json (json)

From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS PSC Team <psc-aws@amazon.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 21:03:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Co-sell PSC integration & transactable SKU migration plan

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can confirm the initial pilot SKUs; I attached our internal SKU export (CSV) and highlighted two licensing exceptions that can't be transacted. Two quick Qs before we lock dates:

1) Can Redwood support private offers for accounts that need seat-based licensing instead of usage metering?
2) For the PSC validation, does AWS require us to provision test-seller accounts or will Redwood provide a sandbox seller?

I put our Sales Ops lead (munna@acmeanalytics.com) on copy — he will share the seller account list by Wed EOB.

We reviewed the MOU draft briefly — a few redlines are needed on the rev-share clause. I'll send the redlined PDF after the seller list.

—
Priya Sharma
Head of GTM, Acme Analytics
priay@acmeanalytics.com

Attachment stubs: acme-sku-export.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:12:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Co-sell PSC integration & transactable SKU migration plan

Quick operational notes from pricing/bizdev — adding here so Priya has visibility:

- Pricing floor: we can accept a 10% promotional runway for the pilot, but baseline must meet the marketplace floor (we'll enforce programmatically).
- Private offers: Redwood supports routing either via our managed billing or via private offers; if Acme picks private offers, we need the seller account IDs (AWS / GCP) and the PO templates by 24 Jul.
- PSC validation: Redwood will provide a sandbox seller account for the AWS PSC test. For GCP we need the listing owner to approve a sandbox test purchase; I copied GCP ops above to coordinate.

I attached a short MOU template (mou-draft.pdf) — once legal redlines come back we'll produce a signed copy.

Vivek
Director, GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: mou-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, AWS PSC Team <psc-aws@amazon.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 20:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell PSC integration & transactable SKU migration plan

Thanks all — quick confirmation note and next steps:

- Priya / Acme: we received the SKU export and your note about two licensing exceptions. Please send the seller account IDs (Munna mentioned Wed EOB) and the redlined MOU when ready.
- We (Redwood) will provision the AWS sandbox seller and schedule the PSC validation window for Mon 27 Jul 09:00–11:00 PT. AWS PSC team: can you confirm availability for that block?
- GCP Ops: please confirm whether you need an additional approval step for the sandbox purchase; if so we’ll pause the production push until GCP signs off.

Action items assigned:
- Acme: seller account list + redlined MOU (Priya / Munna) — due 2026-07-22 EOD.
- Redwood: provision sandbox seller + upload transactable SKUs to staging — due 2026-07-24.
- Redwood legal & Acme legal: exchange MOU redlines — aim sign-off 2026-07-29.

Once we have the seller IDs I’ll open a HubSpot deal note and share the sandbox links. I’ve attached the final mapping that Ben and Olga iterated on; once you confirm we’ll move to staging.

Thanks — Karthik.

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: signed-mou.pdf (pdf, placeholder pending actual signature), psc-mapping-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
